player_prompt.intro:
Yin ee Player {player_id}. Yin ee tiiŋ Memory Game.
Yin ee lɔ̈ɔ̈r tɛ̈ɛ̈n ke ye kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r tɛ̈ɛ̈n, ku ye kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r tɛ̈ɛ̈n ee opponent.
Yin ee tɛ̈ɛ̈n, yɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r rou ku ye column ee kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r rou ee '[0 1 1 0]', ee kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r rou ee 0 ku ye column ee 1, ku ye kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r rou ee 1 ku ye column ee 0.
Yin ee kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r ee match, yin ee kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r ku ye kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r ee face up. Yin ee kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r ee match, ye kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r ee flipped ee face down, e.g. '.'.
Tɛ̈ɛ̈n ee kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r kɔ̈ɔ̈r ee matched, tɛ̈ɛ̈n ee game ee kɔ̈ɔ̈r.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Acie këpuɔth. Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {player_id} akëc bɛ̈n jam në wɛt cï gätpiny ke cït tɛ̈ bï yen lɔ thïn, ku ka cïï tɔ̈u ë kam de kɔ̈th thiin koor yiic.
invalid_move.out_of_bounds: Cɔ̈t ë path. Raan ye gɔl {player_id} acï tɛ̈den tɔ̈u aɣeer bɛ̈n kuanycök.
invalid_move.same_card_twice: Cɔ̈t ë path. Raan ye gɔl {player_id} acï kaar töŋ kuany arak rou.
invalid_move.already_matched: Cɔ̈t ë path. Raan ye wɛ̈ɛ̈r {player_id} acï kaar tök kuany ka rou cï mat wënthɛɛr.

game_message.cards_match: Nhom dwiel ci Luoi {player_id} ee ci nhom [{r1} {c1}] ku [{r2} {c2}] ee kony aye dhuk!
game_message.cards_no_match: Nhom dwiel ci Luoi {player_id} ee këër kony aye dhuk. Nhom dwiel ee ci nhom [{r1} {c1}] ku [{r2} {c2}] ee {pos1} ku {pos2} ci këër.

outcome.draw: Kɔc ye kek mat në kaar kaa rou kedhiɛ aye thöŋ.
outcome.win: Raan ye gɔ̈ɔ̈r {winner_id} acï bɛ̈n tiaam!
outcome.turn_limit: Thïn cï kek thïn. Käärë acë kek. Player 0 acë thok {score_0}, Player 1 acë thok {score_1}.
